capture_settings.authorization: 2026-09-29 user: optimize query-only and explicit-history correction, small tests then all15edges with4GPUs and tmux
capture_settings.fit_objective: query: same-actual-query read residual ridge; history: normalized token and read residual
capture_settings.selection: four fixed Medium/Large development edges; no Max quality tuning

fixed_prediction_identity: same q, same N, same module; query-only ignores K/V, prediction tensor reused exactly

pure_capture_metadata.candidate_rule: half most-recent unique known items from strictly pre-release snapshot, half uniform known catalog; missing recent slots filled uniformly; SeedSequence([17,uid])
pure_capture_metadata.teacher: Current Full on aligned strictly-pre-release history; no feedback labels; mapped-item tie order shared with inherited cache

capture_cost.convention: analytical native FLOPs at actual executed batch and band shapes; each parent capture, rolling append and exact terminal teacher charged once

mixed_capture_metadata.candidate_rule: uniform known catalog without replacement; SeedSequence([17,uid]); no feedback labels
mixed_capture_metadata.cache_state: one genuine Parent-prefix plus Current-rolling-append state per user, strictly before release; parent row key denotes mixed cache
mixed_capture_metadata.mix_assignment: train and validation separately hash-sorted by seed and UID then balanced over append targets; complete timestamp groups; actual append rounded down
mixed_capture_metadata.teacher: exact Current Full recomputation of aligned terminal window, first delta reset to zero; never rolling Current as teacher

limitations: No feedback labels and no AUC; fixed artificial common candidates/time delta for mechanism isolation.
Empirical common-q oracle uses this finite cohort mean, not an estimated population lower bound.
Identification concerns layer0 under identical q,N only; later-layer queries can encode user/cache information.
Cache append-target buckets use a prospectively fixed balanced UID assignment; full-context filtering uses length only.
